port.name: GitUI
port.description: Living Code for GitUI: RON interface themes and matching native TextMate syntax palettes for commit, status and diff views.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/gitui.git
cd gitui
```

On Linux or macOS with the default location:

```sh
mkdir -p "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/gitui"
cp themes/*.ron themes/*.tmTheme "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/gitui/"
gitui -t living-code-night.ron
```

On Windows, use `%APPDATA%\gitui`. Both the RON and corresponding `.tmTheme` file must be in that same directory.
guide.configuration: To make a flavor the default, copy its `.ron` file to `theme.ron` in the GitUI configuration directory; keep the named `.tmTheme` there too. Every override uses the required `Some(...)` representation. The RON `syntax` setting is the TextMate filename stem. Syntax palettes distinguish values, variables, functions, types, properties, comments and diff scopes.
guide.compatibility: Requires GitUI’s optional-override RON format introduced in 0.23, plus custom TextMate syntax loading. Verified against the pinned upstream `Theme` fields. GitUI does not expose a general body foreground/background override: configure a matching Living Code terminal palette for unpainted areas, especially with Paper. The port includes UI and syntax files rather than merely renaming an existing generic theme.
